title: spec: the security-catalog migration entry and the D6 override gloss still say a permission set holds one name per deployment
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mswnWm181XgYcCUag

Follow-up of #32758 (PR #33384), its dev report 6882046858 `open_questions` 1 and 2. Seat ruling: option B for both, one card.

Since #31698 PR 2 (PR #32742) a permission-set name is held once per namespace, so two present-tense spec sentences are false for permission sets:

- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.security-catalog-environment-overlay-refused.ts`, `reason`: "Positions, permission sets and capabilities hold one name per deployment". The entry's subject (an environment row and a package holder never share a name) still holds.
  **TO:** reword the reason around that subject, e.g. "the environment catalog and a package never hold one name"; `id`, `surface`, `replacement` unchanged. Prose only, `@objectstack/spec` patch.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts:251-252`, the `adr_0146_d6_security_catalog` gloss "D6: one name per deployment (permission sets, positions, capabilities)".
  **TO:** "D6: the security catalog takes no override (permission sets, positions, capabilities)". Comment only.

`Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none`. Waits for #33384 to merge (same subject; avoids two texts disagreeing mid-flight).
